mapper.select: SELECT id, code, name, unit_type AS unitType, level FROM org_unit WHERE deleted = 0 AND parent_id IS NULL ORDER BY sort_order, id LIMIT 1
SELECT id, code, name, unit_type AS unitType, level, parent_id AS parentId FROM org_unit WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT id FROM org_unit WHERE deleted = 0 AND unit_type = 'VNPT_TINH' AND status = 'HIEU_LUC'
SELECT id, code, name, from_year AS fromYear, to_year AS toYear FROM evaluation_stage WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY from_year DESC
SELECT id, code, name, from_year AS fromYear, to_year AS toYear FROM evaluation_stage WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT ek.period_code FROM evaluation_result r JOIN evaluation_kpi ek ON ek.id = r.evaluation_kpi_id WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND r.org_unit_id = #{unitId} AND ek.year = #{year} AND r.final_result IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ek.period_code ORDER BY FIELD(ek.period_code, 'Q1', 'Q2', 'H1', 'Q3', 'Q4', 'Y') DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.sql: s.org_unit_id AS unitId, o.code AS unitCode, o.name AS unitName, o.unit_type AS unitType, o.level, o.parent_id AS parentId, s.year, s.period_code AS period, s.total_kpi AS totalKpi, s.achieved, s.not_achieved AS notAchieved, s.tracking, s.warning, s.completion_rate AS completionRate, s.bsc_score AS bscScore, s.rank_in_group AS rankInGroup, s.rank_group AS rankGroup, s.prev_bsc_score AS prevBscScore, s.prev_rank AS prevRank, s.computed_at AS computedAt
mapper.select: SELECT o.id AS unitId, o.code AS unitCode, o.name AS unitName, r.final_result AS finalResult, r.completion_rate AS completionRate, r.score, r.bsc_score AS bscScore, r.rating, r.status FROM evaluation_result r JOIN evaluation_kpi ek ON ek.id = r.evaluation_kpi_id JOIN org_unit o ON o.id = r.org_unit_id WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND ek.kpi_id = #{kpiId} AND ek.year = #{year} AND ek.period_code = #{period} AND o.parent_id = #{parentId} ORDER BY o.sort_order, o.code
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM org_unit WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND deleted = 0
